name: Sekolah Dian Harapan Makassar
address: Jl. Gunung Agung No.201, Tanjung Merdeka, Tamalate, Kota Makassar

steps.en: Register online via the SDH website.

steps.id: Unggah dokumen (atau serahkan langsung ke kampus).
steps.en: Upload documents (or hand in hard copies at the campus).

steps.id: Bagian admission menginformasikan jadwal tes masuk; tes bisa di kampus atau online.
steps.en: Admissions informs you of the entrance test date; tests can be on campus or online.

documents.en: One copy of last year's report card

test.id: Kelas 1: psikotes, wawancara siswa & orang tua. Kelas 2–6: psikotes, Matematika, Bahasa Inggris, Bahasa Indonesia, wawancara.
test.en: Grade 1: psychological test, student & parent interview. Grades 2–6: psychological test, maths, English, Indonesian, interview.

period.id: Prosedur jaringan SDH per November 2026; situs tidak menyebut tahun ajaran. Biaya kampus tidak dipublikasikan.
period.en: SDH network procedure as of November 2026; the site does not state the year. Campus fees are not published.
